mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.location, d.is_private, d.status, d.view_count, d.comment_count, d.like_count, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.mood_id, m.name AS moodName, m.emoji AS moodEmoji, d.weather_id, w.name AS weatherName, w.emoji AS weatherEmoji FROM diary as d LEFT JOIN mood as m ON m.id = d.mood_id LEFT JOIN weather as w ON w.id = d.weather_id WHERE d.id = #{ id } AND d.deleted = 0
